agyos_skill.intent: Manage Travis CI pipelines, monitor build health, retrieve and analyze job logs, compare builds, and optimize CI performance via the Travis CI MCP server (API v3).
agyos_skill.instructions: Operate and inspect Travis CI pipelines directly from AI agent workflows using the `travis-mcp` Model Context Protocol server. Provides build triggers, job inspection, automated failure debugging, build comparisons, and caching optimization recommendations. The launcher script [`travis-mcp.sh`](file:///home/ai/Documents/projects/Freelance/AGYOS/mcp/travis-mcp.sh) reads the API token in this precedence: 1. `TRAVIS_CI_TOKEN` environment variable 2. `~/.config/travis-mcp/token` (file with permissions `600`) To configure credentials securely: ```bash mkdir -p ~/.config/travis-mcp echo -n "YOUR_TRAVIS_API_TOKEN" > ~/.config/travis-mcp/token chmod 600 ~/.config/travis-mcp/token ``` | Tool | Purpose | Read/Write | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `travis_getBuildLogs` | Fetch aggregated log output across all jobs of a build | Read | | `travis_getBuildJobs` | Inspect job IDs, matrix configurations, and states for a build | Read | | `travis_getOwnerStats` | Retrieve repository counts, build volume, and user/org metrics | Read | | `travis_getServiceStatus` | Verify Travis CI API and backend infrastructure operational state | Read | | `travis_getBuildInsights` | Extract automated diagnostic summaries and error root causes | Read | | `travis_getOptimizationRecommendations` | Analyze job timings and propose caching and parallelization speedups | Read | | `travis_compareBuilds` | Side-by-side build comparison to locate regressions or timing drift | Read | | `travis_triggerBuild` | Start a new build for a repo/branch with optional `.travis.yml` overrides | Write | | `travis_restartBuild` | Re-run an existing build by ID | Write | | `travis_cancelBuild` | Terminate a running or queued build | Write | 1. **Check Service Health & State**: - Call `travis_getServiceStatus` if API issues are suspected. - Call `travis_getOwnerStats` with `owner="owner-name"` to list repos and build statuses.
